title: James E. Faust
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Ruth Wright, Salt Lake Temple; five children
Bishop, High Councilor, Stake President, Regional Representative
Presidency of First Quorum of Seventy 1976-78
Ordained Apostle and sustained to Twelve 1978
Second Counselor to Gordon B. Hinckley, 1995-2007
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
